blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of Civil Defense (OCD) is set to launch a seven-point resilience agenda and an infrastructure development plan aimed at strengthening the country’s disaster preparedness and response capabilities as it marks its 72nd anniversary. OCD Deputy Administrator Rafaelito Alejandro IV said the agency’s 7-Point Resilience Agenda, also referred to as Prepapre, and its Strategic Infrastructure Development and Management Plan (SIDMP) would help address evolving disaster risks and growing demands for its services. Alejandro said the agency must continue adapting to advances in technology, sustainability requirements and changes in disaster risk governance. “Filipinos have always shown courage and […]...
